summary: Materialise NV, a Belgian 3D-printing software and services company, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release updating progress on its previously announced share buyback program. During 28 September-2 October 2026, the company repurchased 108,902 ordinary shares at an average price of EUR 7.54 for EUR 821,459, all through Nasdaq's central order book. Since the program began 26 January 2026, Materialise has bought back 1,495,429 shares for EUR 7,999,380, equal to 2.5% of shares outstanding, under a discretionary mandate capped at EUR 30 million. Watch execution pace and any buyback-related EPS or liquidity effects.
